edges.reason: ContextMixin.msgSender reads msg.sender directly.
ERC721Tradable._msgSender returns the value produced by ContextMixin.msgSender.
Resolved msg sender is compared to the owner/proxy inside mint's authorization assert.
msg.sender flow into the assert-based access control gate.
mint executes the assert access-control statement before minting.
mint calls canMint inside a require before minting.
mint performs an external call to UselessNFT.mintTo allowing control transfer to another contract.
canMint computes USELESSNFTS_SUPPLY - numItemsAllocated.
Factory transferFrom delegates into mint with attacker supplied token id.
ownerOf shim participates in the OpenSea mint/approval flow that reaches mint.
executeMetaTransaction performs address(this).call with user supplied data, re-entering the contract.
ERC721Tradable.mintTo forwards the recipient into ERC721._mint.
fireTransferEvents loop bound derives from NUM_OPTIONS.
Factory transferOwnership override invokes Ownable.transferOwnership via super.
onlyOwner modifier guards the privileged mint function.
onlyOwner compares msg sender against owner().
executeMetaTransaction reads and increments the nonces mapping for replay protection.
mint reads proxyRegistryAddress to build the ProxyRegistry instance.
isApprovedForAll reads proxyRegistryAddress for proxy lookup.
mint reads nftAddress to construct the UselessNFT instance.
canMint reads nftAddress to query totalSupply.
_getNextTokenId reads _currentTokenId.
_incrementTokenId writes _currentTokenId.
executeMetaTransaction uses userAddress as the meta transaction sender.
executeMetaTransaction uses functionSignature in the low level call.
executeMetaTransaction passes sigR into verify.
executeMetaTransaction passes sigS into verify.
executeMetaTransaction passes sigV into verify.
numItemsAllocated feeds the supply subtraction arithmetic.
newTokenId is the id minted by mintTo.
mintTo calls _getNextTokenId.
mintTo calls _incrementTokenId after minting.
_optionId selects the branch/bundle size inside mint.
_toAddress flows into the external mintTo callback loop.
uselessNFTinstance is the target of the external mintTo reentrancy-prone calls.
uselessNFTinstance is used by canMint to read totalSupply.
_to is the recipient used by mintTo.
returnTokenContractOwnership externally calls transferOwnership on the NFT contract.
tokenURI concatenates baseURI with the option id.

normalization_plan.reason: _optionId is a parameter consumed only by UselessNFTsFactory.mint and should be merged into that function node.
_toAddress is a parameter of mint directly flowing into the external mintTo call site (unsafe external interaction).
_to is a parameter used only by ERC721Tradable.mintTo and is merged there.
userAddress is a parameter used only by executeMetaTransaction.
functionSignature is a parameter used only by executeMetaTransaction's low-level call.
sigR is a signature parameter used only by executeMetaTransaction verification.
sigS is a signature parameter used only by executeMetaTransaction verification.
sigV is a signature parameter used only by executeMetaTransaction verification.
numItemsAllocated is a local variable feeding the supply arithmetic unsafe operation.
newTokenId is a local variable computed and minted inside mintTo.
uselessNFTinstance is the local contract handle used for the external mintTo calls performed by mint.
